company.name: HoloFair
company.shortDescription: HoloFair is a platform for virtual events, digital exhibitions, and online networking experiences for businesses and communities.
company.description: HoloFair is a digital platform focused on virtual events, online exhibitions, and interactive networking experiences. The platform provides tools for hosting virtual trade fairs, conferences, webinars, and business events through customizable online environments. It supports features such as virtual booths, attendee interaction, live presentations, chat systems, and event management tools designed for organizations, exhibitors, and participants operating in remote or hybrid settings.
